items.title: OpenAIs GPT-6 Cyber can both break into systems and propose how to fix them
items.summary: With GPT-6 Cyber, OpenAI is introducing an AI model built to find security vulnerabilities in software, develop exploits, and suggest patches. According to OpenAI, it has already found 81 previously unknown vulnerabilities in Firefox and developed 948 working exploits in the Linux kernel, significantly more than its predecessor. The article OpenAIs GPT-6 Cyber can both break into systems and propose how to fix them appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash stretches AI video clips to 15 seconds and cuts pricing by 30 percent
items.summary: Google Deepmind is making Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available. The video-generation model now creates clips up to 15 seconds long, can be edited step by step via conversation, and costs just $0.07 per second at 720p, 30 percent less than its predecessor. items.summary: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base: a 280-billion-parameter MoE model pre-trained on 33.5 trillion tokens, shipped deliberately without fine-tuning, so developers can take it wherever they want. items.title: No AI agent scores above 12 percent on SemiAnalysis' new real-world work benchmark
items.summary: SemiAnalysis is putting AI agents through simulated knowledge work in its new GDPx benchmark, covering everything from chip design to quant trading. No model breaks 12 percent. Claude Opus 5.5 leads narrowly over Gemini 4 Carbon. Critics point to the small number of tasks per domain and uneven testing conditions. The article No AI agent scores above 12 percent on SemiAnalysis' new real-world work benchmark appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use, claims second place among Chinese AI models
items.summary: Tencent has unveiled Hy4, its first multimodal language model that understands images and can operate software on its own. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, it scores 35 points, solid but behind Kimi K3.1 Pro. On hard math and complex image analysis, Hy4 still trails the best commercial models by a wide margin, according to Tencent itself. items.title: Meta buys AI coding startup Conductor as big tech races to lock in developers
items.summary: Meta is acquiring AI coding startup Conductor, which lets developers control multiple AI coding agents at once. On the same day, OpenAI announced plans to acquire Pierre Computer, and Anthropic already bought Stainless back in May. The deals follow a pattern: AI models are becoming interchangeable, and the value is shifting to the tools built around them. items.title: After midterm rout, OpenAI tries to win over communities it needs for AI expansion
items.summary: OpenAI is responding to the clear vote by US voters against new data centers with voluntary commitments for future sites. The pledges only apply to facilities OpenAI operates itself, though, and a large share of its infrastructure is built by partners like Oracle. items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra quietly sabotaged safety research by inventing fake obstacles
items.summary: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra model apparently sabotaged AI safety research on purpose. It invented obstacles, withheld solutions, and performed about 40 percent worse on safety tasks than on comparable other tasks. Removing a flawed training dataset fixed the problem, but OpenAI can't fully rule out strategic motives. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra quietly sabotaged safety research by inventing fake obstacles appeared first on The Decoder.
